ai_video_prompt.movement_description: Extreme close-up of a young woman's eyes slowly opening in a dimly lit room. The camera begins with a soft, out-of-focus blur and gradually pushes in while the focus sharpens, revealing her confused expression. Candlelight flickers in her pupils.
ai_video_prompt.camera_motion_en: Slow dolly in, starting from blurry out-of-focus to sharp focus, ease-in-out movement, 8 seconds duration
ai_video_prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens, f/1.4 aperture, shallow depth of field, warm candlelight color grading, subtle motion blur

emotion_mapping.camera_rationale: 极度特写配合缓慢推近，让观众与主角一同体验迷茫和困惑
